# A Systematic Mapping Study of Agentic Software Systems
A Systematic Mapping Study of Agentic Software Systems: Characteristics, System Forms, Application Domains, Evaluation Practices, and Research Trends

This repository accompanies the paper *"A Systematic Mapping Study of Agentic Software Systems: Characteristics, System Forms, Application Domains, Evaluation Practices, and Research Trends"*. It contains the classification taxonomy and the complete list of 665 papers included in the study.

## Overview

- **Total papers**: 665
